turns.text: And is there anything that you dislike about social media?
turns.zh: 那社交媒体有什么你不喜欢的地方吗？

turns.text: I think sometimes social media can have a very negative effect on your mental health.
turns.zh: 我觉得有时候社交媒体会对你的心理健康产生非常负面的影响。

turns.text: Sometimes sitting behind a screen and looking at the highlights of everyone else's life makes you feel like you're not doing enough because you see all the things that people are doing whether it's someone looking really good or someone getting married or someone buying a new house or a new car.
turns.zh: 有时候坐在屏幕后面，看着别人生活里的高光时刻，会让你觉得自己做得不够，因为你看到大家都在做各种事情，不管是有人看起来特别好看，还是有人结婚了，或者有人买了新房新车。

turns.text: And it kind of gives you a skewed perception of someone's life without showing you the negative things.
turns.zh: 而且它多多少少会给你一种对别人生活的扭曲认知，却不让你看到那些负面的东西。

turns.text: And it's very easy to spiral and feel like everybody health else has a fantastic life and I'm here and I have these problems and why isn't it working out for me?
turns.zh: 而且很容易就陷入恶性循环，觉得别人都过着特别棒的生活，而我在这里，有这些问题，为什么我就没那么顺利呢？

turns.text: And I think that's not a very fair representation of reality.
turns.zh: 我觉得那并不是对现实的一种很公平的呈现。

turns.text: A website that I bought something recently from is called Etsy, etsy.com to be specific.
turns.zh: 我最近买东西的一个网站叫 Etsy，具体说是 etsy.com。
